SlashZero - Gameplay Trailer | PS5 Games
SlashZero is a 3D side-scrolling action roguelike game.

As a player, you will become a time hacker and be able to traverse across multiple timelines.
Make full use of your action skills and combat strategies, collect items, hunt for clues, piece together the truth, and bring down the final boss!

The feel of the controls, the build configuration, and every aspect of the combat are entirely up to you!

Timehacker, are you ready to dive into a random timeline!
